passage:
When snow fell in the mountain village, new teacher Ms. Reed was more excited than her students. She had never seen real snow before.
The students laughed because snow was normal to them. They showed her how to walk safely, how to make a snowball, and why wet gloves were a problem.
During lunch break, Ms. Reed made her first snowman. It was small and uneven, but she took many pictures.
Later, she told the class, "Today you were my teachers."
The students were proud. They realized that even adults and teachers can be beginners.
The first snow was not new to the village, but it became new again through Ms. Reed's eyes.
